subject.title: refactor: own model discovery by runtime lifecycle

question: Should this PR be accepted with `loadModelCatalog` retained as a deprecated compatibility wrapper over lifecycle-owned snapshots while process-global API-provider publication remains a separately tracked follow-up?
rationale: The branch deliberately preserves a released Plugin SDK contract while changing its ownership model; deciding whether that temporary compatibility boundary is acceptable is a durable maintainer API decision, not a mechanical repair.

options.title: Accept the bounded compatibility bridge
options.body: Merge with the deprecated wrapper retained, require internal callers to use prepared APIs, and track process-global publication ownership separately.

options.title: Require the SDK ownership redesign first
options.body: Pause this branch until the public SDK publication path is moved out of process-global state in the same reviewed design.

options.title: Split the public SDK compatibility change
options.body: Land only the internal lifecycle refactor after separating any externally visible SDK contract changes into a focused proposal.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded compatibility bridge
recommendation.body: Merge with the deprecated wrapper retained, require internal callers to use prepared APIs, and track process-global publication ownership separately.

likelyOwner.reason: The current branch and its documented designed follow-up center on this lifecycle and SDK-boundary decision.
